copied from the template at placement; renderer: bit 1 picks clipped/textured by the near-camera grid flag, bit 2 uses a cell-radius visibility test, 0x80 marks objects drawn this frame (cleared each frame, read by hinge depth sorting); bit 4 accepts interactions at any bearing; 0x20 selects the unbiased textured queue. 6 literal sites

latch 0/1 one-shot; pattern bit0 picks the pair member and bit1 keeps it applied; region low nibble callback/signal/set-control and 0x80 repeat; pattern layer flag 0xff unchanged / 0 clear / 0x80 reveal other layer; copy field set 0x2d shared by door/hinge/cell-copy objects (MAP_OBJECT_CELL_COPY_FIELDS moved to the header); event pool 0x17c x16; animated lighting byte index mask/reverse flag; map lighting &0x3f uses KF_MAP_CELL_LIGHTING_MASK. Data bytes from map resources keep untyped storage. ~35 literal sites. Action timers (previous 24/31/300/332) and reaction_mode (0/1/5, lane A consumer) stay numeric

TMD mode bytes are GPU primitive codes: enqueue paths OR the semi-transparency bit (0x02) into GT3/GT4 codes and write FT3/GT3/GT4/FT4|semi and G3/G4; tpage &0xff9f clears ABR before OR-ing the blend; notifications draw additive then subtractive (ABR 1/2 << 5); render_textured_quad skips SetSemiTrans for 0xff; ResetGraph 0 at OPEN/END display start, 3 before overlay hand-off; TMD slot 0 is the map-cell model; PSX starts at overlay OPEN. Kept as plain constants at SDK word boundaries. ~40 literal sites. GetTPage/SetDefDispEnv/SetDefDrawEnv/setlen geometry, P_TAG lengths and colour/coordinate arguments stay numbers (SDK quantities)

render_list passes 1 for shop/stock lists and 3 for trade (object 96 counter instead of gold); 2 omits the second row. The card browser toggles its start/load rows and the preview footer its accept/decline rows. Other cursor initialisations are first-row positions and stay 0. 12 literal sites

hinge door: swings 32 ticks (cells copied at 24), 31 jumps to the 280 hold, closing from 300 when unblocked to 332; placement parks at 999 (KF1 KfMapObjectProgress uses 31/32/300/332). action_timer stays numeric: each operation runs its own step machine (containers wait at 1, doors close at 20/21, 99 parks), so one shared enum would merge unrelated states. 8 literal sites
